name: Have I Been Pwned
description: Search email addresses and domains against the world's most widely used data breach corpus. Have I Been Pwned helps individuals determine whether their accounts have appeared in known breaches and enables organisations to investigate exposure across verified domains. Explore detailed breach information, identify exposed data types, review paste and stealer log exposure, and gain trusted security intelligence to better understand account compromise and cyber risk.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Have I Been Pwned to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Have I Been Pwned to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://haveibeenpwned.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Have I Been Pwned MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Have I Been Pwned lists 17 MCP tools, including hibp_list_breaches, hibp_get_breach, hibp_get_latest_breach, hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_pwned_passwords_range, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_breached_account_range, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_breached_domain, hibp_list_subscribed_domains, hibp_get_subscription_status, and hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Have I Been Pwned?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Have I Been Pwned in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Have I Been Pwned MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Have I Been Pwned requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Have I Been Pwned?

acceptedAnswer.text: Have I Been Pwned is developed by Have I Been Pwned. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
